scientific_hypothesis: A bounded tokenless public-observation action-effect memory learned from prior real pickup/drop experiments selects a better first physical intervention and relocation site in unfamiliar BlockedUnlockPickup than a matched same-information generic nonlearning route-repair policy. The route-repair scaffold is shared; merely reaching the goal or clearing obstacles does not demonstrate learning contribution.
policy_inputs: Only 7x7x3 local image and compass direction, own actions and charged feedback/rewards, within-episode estimated topological map and frozen learned counts. Never mission, environment id in policy, privileged hidden state, target coordinates, room grid or simulator oracle.
architecture: Nontransformer non-next-token bounded event graph; fixed public-view navigator; synthetic MiniGrid study external research only. No native Yggdrasil weights, model integration or controller change.

frozen_mechanism.candidate: Learn public-action pickup clears front and drop occupies front as conditional effects from common earlier-family paid actions. Use learned effects with a public-view topological map to choose obstacle removal and drop site by evaluating projected route obstruction. Unseen object type cannot be handled by literal ball ID. Key/door/box progression still uses inherited scripted navigator and must be credited to it.
frozen_mechanism.blind: Same fixed public-view navigator, same repaired post-obstacle state, same action budget and sensory information, generic pickup/drop heuristic chooses nearest empty drop site without using learned effect counts. Must be included as strong no-learning control; all other route repairs shared.
frozen_mechanism.permuted: Same model memory, shared training, and decision capacity as candidate, but learned action-effect identities permuted at prediction time. No special sabotaged environment or altered action space.
frozen_mechanism.md23: Frozen MD23 causal graph on identical new shared physical demonstrations but without unknown-object intervention handler.
frozen_mechanism.conventional: Identical frozen fully trained tabular-Q and 12-hidden recurrent imitation baselines, shared positive demonstration and interference trajectories, no new heldout learning.
frozen_mechanism.pretrained_ceiling: Do not claim superiority over fixed navigation scaffold even on success; no learned navigation assertion.
frozen_mechanism.first_use_policy: No official registered seed invocation until complete dual-OS prefirstuse toy proof of novel goal coverage, learning-specific route divergence, no cheating, frozen dependent atlas/full regression. Then unique exact draft PR opening once per OS, no synchronize/rerun. No registered first use from arbitrary push, local command, or toy smoke.
